t: This logic block can be placed with its input side facing an $(thing)energy block$(). It has a GUI that you can use to control the power range where it should emit a $(thing)redstone signal$(). $(br2)Redstone is emitted when the power level is above the minimum percentage and below the maximum percentage.
这个逻辑方块可以放置，使其输入面朝向一个$(thing)能源方块$()。它有一个 GUI，你可以用来控制它应发出$(thing)红石信号$()的能量范围。$(br2)当能量水平高于最小百分比且低于最大百分比时，就会发出红石信号。
